cohort: All deliveries in Lithuanian hospitals in 2012 and 2014
finding: The Ten Group Classification System (TGCS) was associated with a reduction in caesarean section rates among nulliparas, particularly in Robson groups 1 and 2B, without a negative impact on perinatal mortality.
